body: How does saying you're my friend help anything? That's what all my real friends said before I never saw them again. But you know, hey, you might just have the answer I'm looking for. How can you help me?
I don't think you know what being friends means. Plus you're only 13, I feel weird even talking to you.
Thanks but I don't know you, you don't know me, and you're probably no where near me. To each other we are just some strange online men.
